TaskDescription: Category-level Structured condition: trial-unique scene photographs whose scene categories were paired across repetitions (e.g., beach always followed by canyon). Each image 250 ms, then 250 ms inter-stimulus interval.
Instructions: Participants passively viewed a rapid stream of scene images and were asked to pay attention to each image. Before the category-level structured runs, patients were told that they would be viewing images of scene categories and were given the names of the six categories; they were not informed about the category pairs nor that the sequence contained pairs or a predictable order (Sherman et al. 2023, Methods, Procedure).
iEEGReference: Signals were referenced to an electrode chosen by the clinical team to minimize noise in the recording (Dryad methods).
iEEGPlacementScheme: Clinically determined implant (Sherman et al. 2023: 'Electrode placement was determined solely by the clinical care team to localize seizure foci'). Table 1: implant type combined (depth electrodes plus subdural grid/strip electrodes); hemisphere: primarily right; 191 contacts.

StimulusPresentation.SoftwareName: MATLAB (The MathWorks) with the Psychophysics Toolbox; experiment run on a laptop while the participant was seated in the hospital bed (Sherman et al. 2023, Methods, Stimuli and Procedure)
